items.hook: Meier Helmbrecht is a 1928 play by the German writer Eugen Ortner.
items.body: A historical tragedy set around 1250, it was first staged at the Munich Kammerspiele. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Mickey Zacchilli is an American comics artist and voice actor, currently known for portraying the character Little Destiny in the adult animated television series Adventure Time: Fionna and Cake.
items.body: She has been nominated for three Ignatz Awards, including as an editor for Outstanding Anthology with Lovers Only in 2018, Outstanding Graphic Novel with RAV in 2015, and Outstanding Minicomic with RAV #6 in 2012. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Zmievskaya Balka is a site in Rostov-on-Don, Russia at which 27,000 Jews and other Soviet civilians were massacred from 1942 to 1943 by the SS Einsatzgruppe D during the Holocaust in Russia.
items.body: It is considered to be the largest single mass killing site of Jews in the Russian SFSR during the Second World War. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
